CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinates for red at p0/current/n3), an explicit presentation/access marker (origin), and a differentiating status (origin kind) are present for the same referent/time; scopes mix (display vs access) so binding scope is unclear.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is explicitly linked to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (color labels with coordinate sets) are present for current and candidate entries.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (different kinds for different n indices) separately mark the content's status/representation source, distinguishing identification from status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Text explicitly states organization/presentation categories (current vs candidate) and includes origin/access markers for specific entries.
